task.title: Preserve workflow-phase corrections as linked task evidence
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/751 with an explicit phase-assisted turn that records the provider response as a Correction linked to one caller-selected Attempt.
acceptance_criteria: Validate the active association, fresh Correction ID, exact parent Attempt, writable session, and phase bindings before provider work.
Persist a valid response atomically as assistant content and linked Correction evidence.
Preserve only the human turn on provider failure or blank response.
Do not create an Attempt, Verification, workflow transition, or tool grant.

attempts.diagnostic: The focused workflow-phase runtime suite failed because execute_workflow_phase_task_correction_turn did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added selected-skill, exact-lineage, invalid-preflight, provider-failure, and durability tests.

attempts.diagnostic: The task aggregate already owned parent-Attempt validation, while the phase runtime already owned fail-closed skill composition.
attempts.patch: Composed the existing boundaries and generalized atomic assistant/evidence persistence without widening provider authority.

attempts.summary: Completed substantive review without actionable findings.
attempts.diagnostic: Hosted review covered the runtime, task store, tests, and decision documentation at the exact implementation head.
attempts.patch: Preserved the reviewed single-commit implementation unchanged.

outcome.summary: One explicitly selected phase can produce durable Correction evidence linked to an exact Attempt, while task terminal state and workflow lifecycle remain caller-owned.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test -p vela-kernel --test workflow_phase_runtime

lessons: Corrective model output should preserve exact attempt lineage rather than be flattened into another Attempt.
The stricter evidence type must be validated before a provider response reaches durable transcript state.
Phase composition can remain explicit and useful without implying workflow execution provenance.
